GENERAL PROVISIONS

161.005 Short title. ORS 161.005 to 161.055 shall be known as the Oregon Criminal Code. [1971 c.743 §1]

161.015 General definitions. As used in ORS 161.005 to 161.055, unless the context requires otherwise:

161.055 (2) does not apply to an affirmative defense described in 161.015 (3).

[1971 c.743 §3; 1973 c.836 §339; 2025 c.161 §4]
